correctness.rationale: The Gaussian divisor sum factors as products of geometric Euler factors over nonassociate primes, whose norm multiset has one ramified 2, duplicate split primes q=1 mod4 and squared inert norms. The interval-overlap lemma requires tail maximum T_j >= 1+N_j^{-3/2}; for every norm N>=29 a split q in (N,3N/2] contributes TWO later Gaussian prime factors, and 2*(3/2)^(-3/2)>1. Independent primality/ratio validation covers the 73 split-prime chain 37 to 8856541433 for all N from 29 through 8e9, and exact rational inequalities verify all five small cases. Bennett–Martin–O’Bryant–Rechnitzer explicit theta bound supplies every larger N. The upper Euler product is zeta_Q(i)(3/2), absolutely convergent.
risk: The finite witness chain alone is insufficient for arbitrarily large N: the independently checked external explicit prime-AP theorem is an essential analytic premise.
Result describes closure, not surjectivity or every exponent.
